The 'start(7)' section lists 'HB', strike planning, insurrection, staging areas, 'HB indicator', 'starting interupt' and 'r. point'. 'HB indicator' is the Hidden Base marker/system choice, not a card, and is left out; 'starting interupt' names no card and is kept as one UNKNOWN row. Total 60 on that reading (61 lines posted; the Interrupts header says 25 but 26 are listed). Several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty.

Posted 'courage' dested Courage Of A Skywalker (Cloud City interrupt; Warrior's Courage is the other possibility); 'revo' Revolution; 'honor' Honor Of The Jedi; 'twas kha' Tawss Khaa; 'orinmarko' Orrimaarko; 'lando w axe' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'wedge' Wedge Antilles; 'anakins' Anakin's Lightsaber; 'falcon' Millennium Falcon.

Posted 'epp obi' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'epp leia' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'jedi luke' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Capt solo' Captain Han Solo; 'endor docking bay' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); Sense and Alter are the Light Premiere interrupts.
The post says the idea came from what Gerry Carmen played at Worlds Day 2.
